sentences.text: Its name highlights a beak that looked remarkably like a turtle's shell opening.
Except for the head, the creature had strong legs and tiny wings that could not fly.
Scientists described the species in 1991 using old bones found in 1976 by Storrs Olson in the Makawehi dunes on Kauai.
Additional remains were later uncovered at the nearby Makauwahi Cave site.
The unique beak shape implies the bird ate plants, a trait that converges with tortoises.
The genus Chelychelynechen includes only this single species.
It belongs to the family Anatidae.
This animal evolved within the Hawaiian Islands situated in the North Pacific Ocean.
It lived during the Holocene period, spanning from 0.0117 to 0 million years ago.
